en.title: Motorola Transistor Concept
en.blurb: A hobbyist 3D project - the iconic Motorola transistor radio reimagined, from model and materials to lighting and animation.
en.about:
A personal 3D project: the iconic Motorola transistor radio reimagined, from the model and carefully chosen materials to lighting and animation. The piece keeps the retro charm of the classic receiver and adds modern updates, so it captures the past while looking at home in the present.

An animation walks around every detail and shows how the receiver works, and the model comes in several colour versions - black, silver, teal, orange and dark.
